preconditions.description: The number of drawings is between 2 and 1000, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if Heidi can recover the Tree of Life from the two drawings.
The output is 'NO' if Heidi cannot recover the Tree of Life from the two drawings.
If the output is 'YES', the number of edges in the recovered Tree of Life is n - 1.

postconditions.expression: if output == 'YES': all(u in drawing1 and v in drawing1 for (u, v) in edges)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', each edge in the recovered Tree of Life is present in the first drawing.

postconditions.expression: if output == 'YES': all(u in drawing2 and v in drawing2 for (u, v) in edges)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', each edge in the recovered Tree of Life is present in the second drawing.

postconditions.expression: if output == 'YES': all(u in drawing1 or v in drawing1 for (u, v) in edges)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', each edge in the recovered Tree of Life has at least one endpoint in the first drawing.

postconditions.expression: if output == 'YES': all(u in drawing2 or v in drawing2 for (u, v) in edges)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', each edge in the recovered Tree of Life has at least one endpoint in the second drawing.
